findings.note: SB 1174 (Min, 2024) bars local governments from requiring a person to show identification to vote in a local election. She is listed as abstaining on the Assembly floor vote (57-16, with abstentions). Source is CalMatters Digital Democracy.

AB 1116 (Berman) requires the Secretary of State, by 2029, to build a way to collect an electronic signature image from someone who registers to vote online without a California driver's license or ID card. She voted yes on the Assembly third reading. Source is CalMatters Digital Democracy.
